recovered_sql_candidate: select     i.i_brand_id as brand_id,     i.i_brand as brand,     sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as ext_price from date_dim d,      store_sales ss,      item i where d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk   and ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk   and i.i_manager_id = 36   and d.d_moy = 12   and d.d_year = 2001 group by i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id order by ext_price desc, i.i_brand_id limit 100
